title: Non-Potential Congestion Games with a Continuum of Players
summary: We study a class of congestion games with a continuum of heterogeneous players and a finite set of resources, without assuming the existence of a potential function. Players differ in their individual characteristics and may contribute differently to congestion, which is represented through general aggregate features of the population choosing each resource. We characterize the conditions under which such a game admits a potential and show that this structure generally fails when players have heterogeneous impacts on congestion.
